inputSemantics: req_epoch_swap (binary; fact: scripts/approve-domain.sh deploy / domains/deployments (epoch request); partial): a rule-epoch swap is requested
gate_3of3_parity (binary; fact: RealityEngine_CI regression run report (parity stages); partial): C++, LSP and Scala agree 3-of-3 on the candidate
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
replay_completed (binary; aigov-replay-analyst completion via aigov.gov04.replay-analyst.completion): the replay is complete
replay_failed (binary; aigov-replay-analyst completion via aigov.gov04.replay-analyst.completion): the agent's step failed
replay_pass (binary; aigov-replay-analyst completion via aigov.gov04.replay-analyst.completion): candidate rules fire on near misses and stay silent on nominal runs
gate_aibom_pinned (binary; fact: AIBOM verifier over the frame's AIBOM document; new): every model, quantization, tap and dictionary digest is pinned
quorum_valid (binary; fact: GOV06 verdict, carried by the frame; new): the approval quorum for this frame is valid

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

M-GOV-04 S1_AgentRunning → S_err_Rejected: [req_epoch_swap=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ replay_completed=0] · [replay_completed=1 ∧ replay_pass=0]
M-GOV-04 S1_Replayed → S_err_Rejected: [req_epoch_swap=1 ∧ gate_3of3_parity=0 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ replay_completed=1]
M-GOV-04 S1_Replayed → S_err_Rejected: [req_epoch_swap=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ replay_completed=1 ∧ gate_aibom_pinned=0]

interconnections.purpose: Hand the frame's GovernanceAssetFrame to GOV13, its next consumer (agentic-workflow-contract.json W2); never infer a governance verdict from document content.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Run the sandbox replay and write its report to the frame's return.

frameInputs.lanes: input cells 2-7, written by the lifecycle (reserved)
frameInputs.facts: every other non-completion input, written into the clone's block by the lifecycle's frame source (GOV-R19)
frameInputs.completion: input cells 8..10, the step agent's completion
